title: CIA Office of Research and Development continues MK Ultra work

tellings.quote: According to John Marx in the search for the manurion candidate, that division was the office of research and development or OARD led by Steven Aldrich.

plain: After MK Ultra, the CIA's secret programme of experiments on the human mind, its work was carried on by a CIA division called the Office of Research and Development, led by a man named Stephen Aldrich. Michels takes this from The Search for the Manchurian Candidate, a book by the writer John Marks. He tells it as the link between the CIA's mind experiments and the later US research into remote viewing, the claimed ability to see distant places with the mind.
